challenge.method: Test the interpretation against two interfaces storing typed-nil slices of the same type, interfaces with different dynamic types, and an interface compared with a nil interface. Compare the underlying slice comparison restriction.
challenge.results: Typed-nil slices stored in interfaces retain their shared incomparable slice type and satisfy the panic condition. A nil interface has no dynamic type, and different dynamic types fail the identity requirement. The special rule allowing a slice to be compared to the nil identifier has a different operand form.

limitations: The exact claim states a sufficient condition within statically valid comparisons. Other panic cases and static validity follow their own rules.
